environment.description: Kubernetes deployment on EKS 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards enforcement set to 'restricted' profile (label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). The namespace also has a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path' that denies any pod spec containing hostPath volumes. Secrets are injected via CSI SecretStore driver from AWS Secrets Manager with rotation every 4 hours. The pod runs as non-root (UID 65534) with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, and drops ALL capabilities. A Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy limits /api/token/validate to max 3 requests per source IP per 10-second window with connection tracking. The service is exposed only through an internal NLB with no public ingress.

config.secrets_injection: AWS Secrets Manager via CSI SecretStore driver, 4hr rotation
config.network_policy: Cilium L7 policy, rate-limit 3 req/10s per source IP on /api/token/validate
config.ingress: internal NLB only, no public endpoint
